metadata.description: Full outbound execution engine for B2B service companies: 19 skills covering deliverability, list building, hypotheses, sequence copy, A/B testing, reporting and reply audits.

plugins.name: outbound-engine
plugins.description: 19 Claude Code skills that execute the outbound block of a GTM system for B2B service companies (agencies, outsourcing, consulting): signal detection, data research, waterfall enrichment, lead scoring, hypothesis building, sequence copy (email + LinkedIn + subject lines + spintax + follow-ups + PS lines), campaign tiering/naming/orchestration, deliverability audit, A/B test analysis, campaign reports, weekly outreach report, and forensic reply audits. Built and battle-tested by Victor Shulga (Fractional CRO).
